prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Phoenix. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Phoenix for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I’ll find several specific orthodontists near you and explain why each is a good call. Before I look them up, a couple quick questions so I can give the best, relevant options:

1. What ZIP code or neighborhood in Phoenix (or nearby city) should I search around?  
2. Do you have dental insurance, and if so which plan? (This affects which offices you should call.)  
3. Do you strongly prefer Invisalign over braces, or are you open to either?  
4. Is this for an adult, teen, or child?

If you want to proceed right away, I can also give immediate general guidance on how to pick and what to ask when you call — useful whether you pick providers I send or search on your own. Sample items I’ll include when I pull specific offices: board certification, Invisalign provider tier (if applicable), years/experience, patient reviews/ratings, technology used (iTero/3D imaging), insurance & financing notes, and why I recommend calling them.

Which ZIP/neighborhood and answers to the questions above?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
